title: Project Map
summary: Explore where EPIC projects are located across California and filter map results by investment area, disadvantaged communities, and low-income communities.

steps.title: Project map overview
steps.body: The Project Map insight helps users explore where EPIC projects are located across California.

steps.title: Access the Project Map tab
steps.body: Go to the Projects page and select the Project Map insight tab under Quick Insights.

steps.title: Review project points and clusters
steps.body: Each point on the map represents a project. Clusters show areas where multiple projects are located close together, helping users understand the geographic reach of EPIC investments.

steps.title: View project details
steps.body: Click a project point to view details such as the project name, status, city, funding amount, and funding progress. You can also click the project link to open the full project page.

steps.title: Use the project list with the map
steps.body: When no filters are applied, you can scroll through the project list and select a project. The map will automatically move to that project’s location.

steps.title: Filter by investment area
steps.body: Apply filters to narrow the map by investment area. For example, select Energy Efficiency to view only projects in that category.

steps.title: Filter by DAC and LI communities
steps.body: You can also filter for projects serving disadvantaged communities and low-income communities. When selected, those project points are highlighted with gold points.

steps.title: Include geocoordinates for map display
steps.body: Projects appear on the map because the related company address includes geocoordinates. When adding a company and address, make sure geocoordinates are included so the project can display correctly on the Project Map.
